scope: Independent root source review; no new execution or performance claim. Mutable source hashes bind observation only.

Entry-owned immutable Arc face prevents address reuse/mutation; exact phase key uses Euclidean modulo96. Palette or color is not part of cached coverage.
Reset defers to submission boundary, and ready tags are monotonically nonreused. Each prepared slot streams GPU-culled jobs, preserving dropped-encoder recovery without CPU GPU completion waits.
Compute publication binding is limited to current job byte length, so stale buffer-tail jobs cannot publish tags.
Focused cancellation/repacking/eviction tests use genuine default atlas pressure. Independent real-font exact oracle is separate evidence; synthetic tests do not replace it.
